first_attempt_defects.claim_says: No instrument other than EO 12379 is shown to have ended this order or its parent before 1982-08-17; no unnamed earlier candidate is disclosed
first_attempt_defects.source_says: The clause's whole content adds two officials, the Director of the Community Services Administration and the Chairman of the Council on Wage and Price Stability. A held source, jobs/ofr-codification-1989/output/texts/EO_12344.txt (OFR editorial note), states that the Community Services Administration was abolished by Pub. L. 97-35 (1981). The 2026-10-21 unnamed-instruments ruling requires every claim to record such an unnamed event as a disclosed earlier candidate end, with its source pinned where held. The claim omits it and does not examine whether the Council on Wage and Price Stability still existed in 1982. If both offices had ceased, nothing in the order still operated before EO 12379.
